description: This file defines classes and functions for querying, fetching, and transforming historical index data from the CBOE API, including query parameter handling, data transformation, and request URL generation.

classes.name: CboeIndexHistoricalQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for CBOE index historical data, including symbol selection, interval, and cache usage.

classes.name: CboeIndexHistoricalData
classes.description: Represents the structure of historical index data, including volume and options trading metrics.

classes.name: CboeIndexHistoricalFetcher
classes.description: Handles transforming queries, fetching data asynchronously from CBOE endpoints, and transforming raw data into structured format.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a standardized query object, setting default start and end dates if missing.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw index data from CBOE endpoints based on the query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw fetched data into structured CboeIndexHistoricalData objects, handling different intervals and filtering by date range.
